items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: was Benny Gruger, if you remember and I used to try to play everything that he played.

ctx.x: Right. Put the record on and play along with it, and they had -- well, they had two or three different saxophone players but the one who lasted with them
was Benny Gruger, if you remember and I used to try to play everything that he played.

I used to listen to the All Star Trio, Wheeler Wadsworth. Wheeler Wadsworth and one of the guys I used to play with later, he was a drummer and he played xylophones. When I worked later with Nat Shilkret and -- Green, Joe Green.
